title: From Lightroom to selection and back
intro: Follow the steps in order. This guide is available even when the local backend is offline.

steps.title: Select the catalog and photographs
steps.body: Open the desired catalog in Lightroom Classic and select all photographs for the service. Check the folder, filters and number of selected photos: only these photos will be prepared.

steps.title: Connect the plugin on first use
steps.body: Start the English local backend on port 8766. In Lightroom, open Library → Plug-in Extras → Configure local connection and connect the app. The English edition uses separate local storage and does not read the Italian edition’s services or connection token.

steps.title: Prepare the service
steps.body: Open Library → Plug-in Extras → Prepare service, choose New service and enter a name. Wait while previews are prepared; the web app opens when preparation finishes. No stars are applied.

steps.title: Configure and analyze in the web app
steps.body: Write your instructions in the single text field or start from a preset, then edit the criteria freely. Choose Local only, Local + OpenAI or Directly OpenAI and set the relevant quantity. OpenAI receives your original text. Review the sample, model and estimate, then explicitly confirm transmission. Moving between steps does not send photographs.

steps.title: Review and confirm the selection
steps.body: Compare photographs in the proposal, include or exclude images, and check those marked Needs review. Uncertain results stay included as a precaution and can increase the total above the requested quantity. Click Confirm selection when satisfied. Every imported photograph remains available in the contact sheet.

steps.title: Confirm the star list in the web app
steps.body: In the Lightroom step, prepare the preview of changes and confirm the list. The candidate count can differ from the number of new stars: for example, 10 candidates with 6 existing ratings require only 4 new stars. Existing ratings and manual decisions are preserved.

steps.title: Apply and verify in Lightroom
steps.body: In Lightroom, open Catalog Settings → Metadata and check that Automatically write changes into XMP is unchecked. Then open Library → Plug-in Extras → Apply stars, check the catalog, service and list, and select the XMP confirmation checkbox in the plugin dialog. Click Apply stars. Check Outcome in the web app; to view candidates, use Library → Plug-in Extras → Show candidates in Lightroom.

notes.title: Resume an OpenAI analysis
notes.body: If analysis stops, use Prepare to resume and calculate a new estimate. With the same criteria, model and previews, valid cached assessments are reused without new calls for those photographs. Always check new assessments, reused results and cost before confirming. An unusable call may already have been billed.

notes.title: Two XMP checkboxes with different purposes
notes.body: The Lightroom checkbox controls automatic writing and must remain unchecked. The checkbox in this plugin only records that you checked the setting; select it before applying stars. The plugin does not change Lightroom preferences.

notes.title: What changes
notes.body: The plugin assigns one star only to eligible candidates with zero stars, after confirmation in both the web app and Lightroom. It does not lower existing ratings, delete photographs, or modify originals, sidecars or develop settings.
